Cc: Raj Patel <raj@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T08:34:00Z
Subject: Request: temporary processor onboarding for FinBank pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro. We (EdgeLens) are supporting a 6-week telemetry pilot with FinBank that will ingest hashed session metadata and routing telemetry to help them triage latency incidents. FinBank asked that EdgeLens be added as a temporary subprocessors entry while the pilot runs (estimated start: Oct 1 — duration: 6 weeks).

Scope summary (short):
- Data: anonymized telemetry (session ids hashed with salt), error/latency metrics, HTTP headers (no PII fields)
- Region: EU (Ireland/Frankfurt)
- Purpose: diagnostics/telemetry for FinBank pilot only
- Duration: 6 weeks + 2-week evidence retention window

We attached a short statement of processing and a preliminary transfer map for the FinBank flow (EdgeLens -> CDN partner -> analytics layer). Can you advise what evidence you need to allow a temporary onboarding (DPA addendum + subprocessor notice)? FinBank requires explicit export/transfer matrix and confirmation of encryption in transit and at rest. They also requested whether EdgeLens will have any ability to decrypt payloads or access customer keys.

Attachments: EdgeLens_Temp_Processor_Statement.pdf, transfer_map_finbank_edge.xlsx

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Sara

Thanks Sara — forwarding to infra and privacy for a quick clearance pass.

Jonas/Marissa, can you triage the items below and flag any hard blockers? FinBank expects the following evidence before they sign the DPA addendum:
- Export/transfer matrix showing every hop and country boundary (we have the preliminary spreadsheet attached)
- Confirmation of encryption (TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest) and whether EdgeLens or its CDN partner holds keys
- Any downstream subprocessors (CDN + analytics provider) with residency info and SOC2/ISO attestation where available
- A limited-data retention statement and confirmation of log redaction policies

If this is operationally straightforward we can issue a temporary subprocessor notice with a 6-week window and require an approved onshore fallback. If we need any extra contractual controls (onshoring, key escrow, or limited KMS access) call it out and I will loop legal and procurement.

I copied FinBank so they see the ask — Sara/Raj, we should be able to move quickly if infra confirms the technical constraints.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary processor onboarding for FinBank pilot

Kimberly / Marissa — quick technical read below. TL;DR: low-risk if we apply tight controls and require the DPA addendum + presigned subprocessor attestations.

Notes:
- EdgeLens architecture as described: telemetry collected in EU regions (ie: ie-west-1 / eu-central-1) and forwarded to their analytics tenant. CDN partner terminates TLS in the same region. That matches the transfer_map_finbank_edge.xlsx but we need vendor/region confirmation for the CDN (name + country) not just a generic description.
- Keys: EdgeLens says they do not hold FinBank keys and will use service-managed keys for analytics storage. We should require either customer-managed KMS (preferred) or a documented escrowing arrangement. No decrypt-capability for EdgeLens should be expressly stated.
- Logging: require immediate redaction of any header fields that could contain session-identifying customer IDs (we will give a redaction pattern). Retention should be capped at 14 days post-pilot unless FinBank requests longer; any extension requires exec-level approval.
- Downstream vendors: require SOC2 Type II or ISO27001 evidence for CDN and analytics partner. If they cannot provide, we should require an onshore fallback or disable export for FinBank tenant.

Recommended next steps:
1) Ask EdgeLens for the CDN vendor name + region and SOC2/ISO certs (if available).
2) Require EdgeLens to sign our DPA addendum (I can draft minimal security controls to attach).
3) Collect the completed transfer_map_finbank_edge.xlsx with vendor columns filled and a short attestation from EdgeLens legal.

If Marissa and Kimberly are happy with this, I will prepare a short technical acceptance checklist and a security addendum draft.

Sara / Raj — thanks for the submission and for the attached transfer map. Next steps and our asks summarized below: 

What we need from EdgeLens by Sep 20 to proceed with a temporary subprocessor notice (pilot window Oct 1 — Nov 12):
- Completed transfer_map_finbank_edge.xlsx with explicit vendor names, country of processing for each hop, and whether each hop stores data at rest.
- Attestation from EdgeLens legal: "EdgeLens will not have the ability to decrypt any FinBank customer data; keys remain under customer control or are managed under documented escrow if service-managed keys are used."
- SOC2/ISO evidence for the CDN partner and analytics provider (PDFs or URL to auditor reports).
- Confirmation of encryption standards (TLS1.2+/AES-256) and where keys are held (EdgeLens-managed or customer-managed).
- Agree to our 14-day retention cap for telemetry and redaction rules (I will send a short redaction pattern doc).

We will prepare a DPA addendum (draft link below) and a short security acceptance checklist. We will not publish the subprocessor roster entry until the above items are received and validated. If any downstream vendor cannot provide attestation, we will require an onshore fallback before enabling FinBank telemetry export.
